source: Original camera-ready composite PDF converted to SVG; only text font is replaced.

palette.original: Matplotlib cool (cyan-to-magenta), unchanged original vector colors and colorbar images

presentation: Original single row, geometry, labels, marker sizes, grid, axes, ticks, pink identity lines and colorbars. Only font substitution.

meanings.x: Reference RUL in cycles, as plotted in the paper.
meanings.y: Predicted RUL in cycles, as plotted in the paper; caption does not specify coordinate aggregation.
meanings.color: Standard deviation of scalar RUL extracted from ten generated SOH trajectories per test sample.
meanings.errorBars: None in the source; none introduced.

limitations: The PDF records exact plotted coordinates and 256 uncertainty color bins, not the ten underlying scalar predictions or raw per-cell standard deviations.
Integer-formatted colorbar labels do not identify exact normalization extrema. No exact sigma values or mean/median aggregation are inferred.
Available seed-2026 uncertainty caches differ from the published figure and are not substituted.
Live text retains original text-run baselines, font sizes and rotation; natural glyph shapes and text advances change with the requested font substitution.

panels.colorbarTickPrecision: Original integer-formatted labels; not exact standard-deviation extrema.
